readiness_gates.name: p5_probabilistic_readiness
readiness_gates.description: Point baselines and residual asymmetry confirm P5 readiness

justification: Point forecasting establishes robust baseline with XGBoost (MAE ~15.4m) and Ridge (MAE ~15.6m) significantly outperforming Median baseline and Zero-delay. Residual distribution exhibits severe skewness and heteroscedasticity, confirming necessity of Phase P5 probabilistic modeling.
